description: Connect Depwire to a codebase for analysis. Accepts a local directory path or a GitHub repository URL. If a GitHub URL is provided, the repo will be cloned automatically. This replaces the currently loaded project.

source.description: Local directory path (e.g., '/Users/me/project') or GitHub URL (e.g., 'https://github.com/vercel/next.js')

subdirectory.description: Subdirectory within the repo to analyze (optional, e.g., 'packages/core/src')

name: connect_repo
